target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android chat was missing two expected controls: a visible new-chat entry point and slash command suggestions in the composer. It also needed the Android operator connection to request the Gateway scope required for `/reset`, and the previous PR body did not expose the connected Android videos as renderable GitHub attachments.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Adds a header `+` / New Chat flow that creates Gateway sessions through `sessions.create` and chooses unique labels such as `New chat`, `New chat 2`, and later increments.
- Wires slash suggestions to Gateway `commands.list` and removes Android hard-coded command fallback behavior.
- Filters slash suggestions by command name or alias prefix only: `/` lists commands, `/n` filters names or aliases starting with `n`, `/mo` matches `/model`, `/de` matches the `/delegate` alias for `/agent`, and `/runtime` or `/session` do not match description/category text.
- Includes Android `operator.admin` in the paired operator scope so Gateway-backed reset commands can run through the intended operator contract.
- Adds focused Android coverage for command filtering, unique new-chat labels, connection scopes, and Gateway session invocation behavior.

Focused verification already run:

- `./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.ConnectionManagerTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionInvokeTest`
- `./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug`
- Connected Android emulator proof recorded against the PR `playDebug` APK through an isolated local Gateway connection.

## User Impact

Android users can start a fresh chat from the chat header, discover slash commands while typing in the composer, use `/new` to start a new session, and use `/reset` against the selected Android session. Command suggestions stay aligned with the connected Gateway instead of relying on an Android-local fallback catalog.

## Evidence

Focused Android JVM tests passed:

- `ChatControllerCommandControlsTest`
- `ConnectionManagerTest`
- `GatewaySessionInvokeTest`

Android APK build passed:

- `:app:assemblePlayDebug`

Connected Android emulator proof:

`+` creates a unique new chat session

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

`/new` starts a new session

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

`/reset` resets the selected Android session

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb

Slash command filtering

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3
